title: Sum With Reduce
instructions:
Complete the `totalScore` function. It takes a `List<Int>` of match scores and returns the sum of all scores.

Use the `.reduce` function to add all the numbers together.

For example, `totalScore(listOf(45, 72, 38))` returns `155`.
hint: Use scores.reduce { acc, score -> acc + score } to add up all elements.
